relations: Joan（叙述者/重写者）；Beatrice（原作者）；Roland（1891 年反串主角）；Greg（未涉）
numbers: 重写始于挑战前数周；戏剧 1891 年春季游园会只演一次；四幕结构

facts.fact: 重写在 refectory 挑战前数周已开始；她说是先手，如今觉得命定
facts.anchor: I’d already started my rewrite weeks before you challenged me
facts.verbatim: I’d already started my rewrite weeks before you challenged me

facts.fact: 自学期初派对起就是她的项目：论文修改搁置、承诺的文章未动笔；不教书不改稿就泡在 Scylla
对 Donahue 没永恒之火，敬其才智/语言/不妥协的古怪；写她出于策略非爱——如今是腹语假人
facts.anchor: not from love but from strategy
facts.verbatim: not from love but from strategy

facts.fact: Scylla 只演一次：1891 春季游园会、女校全女班——除主角：你的爱人 Roland 穿女装演同名角色
facts.anchor: Your lover, Roland, performed the titular character in drag.
facts.verbatim: Your lover, Roland, performed the titular character in drag.

facts.fact: 剧作是维多利亚古典滑稽仿体、对句轻快；合唱用美国山乡土腔（冰镇沙士）
第四幕反转：怪罪蠢笨男友 Glaucous（粗心手肘抛毒）；Scylla 成吞海怪、驱水手入 Charybdis
批评家困惑的转折：滑稽体突然转素体诗、母亲 Hecate 救场、海神娶亲——草率诗解构一切
facts.anchor: It’s a disappointing swerve from a woman who rarely allowed a happy ending
facts.verbatim: It’s a disappointing swerve from a woman who rarely allowed a happy ending

facts.fact: 她的改法：钻进她头脑写她会写的戏仿——无母亲救、无海神真爱、同等黑暗与讥诮
facts.anchor: It was getting in her mind, then writing the parody she would write.
facts.verbatim: It was getting in her mind, then writing the parody she would write.

facts.fact: 删改有亲密感：Donahue 是旧手套；本不给任何人看，只塞抽屉——除了你开口要
facts.anchor: Donahue was an old glove my hand felt warm in.
facts.verbatim: Donahue was an old glove my hand felt warm in.

facts.fact: 结尾：那夜档案馆暗了，她把 Scylla 塞进你门下
facts.anchor: I took my Scylla and tucked her beneath your door.
facts.verbatim: I took my Scylla and tucked her beneath your door.
